description:
General Information
Stocked & Shipped From Lexington, KY
New in the Original Packaging
What is This Part?
This is the Suzuki OEM Complete Brake Hose Replacement Set.
Comes with BOTH Front Brake Hoses and Rear Brake Hose.
Direct Replacement for Years 1988.5 thru 1995
I also carry the the Brake Hose Set for years 1986 thru 1988 in my eBay Store!
What Will I Receive?
Qty 2 – Front Brake Hoses (Fits LH side & RH side)
Qty 1 – Rear Brake Hoses (Fits LH side & RH side)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1988.5 – 1995 All Models
